subjects.subject: Mathematics
subjects.overview: Fundamental study of quantity, structure, space, algebra, calculus, and mathematical change.

rag_chunks.definition: A quadratic equation is a second-order polynomial equation in a single variable x, standard form: ax^2 + bx + c = 0, where a != 0.
rag_chunks.formula: Quadratic Formula: x = (-b +- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a). Discriminant: D = b^2 - 4ac (D > 0 gives two real roots, D = 0 gives one repeated real root, D < 0 gives complex conjugate roots).
rag_chunks.content: Quadratic equations model parabolic trajectories, projectile motions, and area optimizations. Roots can be determined by factoring, completing the square, or applying the quadratic formula directly.

rag_chunks.definition: A derivative measures the instantaneous rate at which a function f(x) changes with respect to its variable x.
rag_chunks.formula: Power Rule: d/dx(x^n) = n*x^(n-1). Product Rule: (uv)' = u'v + uv'. Quotient Rule: (u/v)' = (u'v - uv') / v^2. Chain Rule: d/dx(f(g(x))) = f'(g(x)) * g'(x).
rag_chunks.content: Differentiation is widely utilized in physics for velocity and acceleration calculations and in AI algorithms for gradient descent optimization.

rag_chunks.definition: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers. An eigenvector of a square matrix A satisfies Av = lambda*v where lambda is its eigenvalue.
rag_chunks.formula: Characteristic Equation: det(A - lambda*I) = 0. Inverse: A^(-1) = adj(A) / det(A), valid when det(A) != 0.
rag_chunks.worked_example: For 2x2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]], Determinant det(A) = ad - bc.
rag_chunks.content: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors are the core building blocks of computer vision, 3D transformations, dimensionality reduction (PCA), and recommendation algorithms.

rag_chunks.definition: Probability quantifies the likelihood of occurrence of events under uncertainty, with values ranging from 0 to 1.
rag_chunks.formula: Bayes' Theorem: P(A|B) = [P(B|A) * P(A)] / P(B). Expected Value: E[X] = sum(x * P(x)).
rag_chunks.worked_example: If a diagnostic test has 99% accuracy for a condition affecting 1% of the population, Bayes' theorem reveals true positive probability given a positive test is ~50%.
rag_chunks.content: Bayes' theorem is foundational to probabilistic reasoning, machine learning classification, medical diagnosis, and spam filtering algorithms.

rag_chunks.definition: Integration is the mathematical operation representing the accumulation of quantities and continuous area under curves.
rag_chunks.formula: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus: integral[a to b] f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a), where F'(x) = f(x). Power Rule: integral x^n dx = (x^(n+1))/(n+1) + C.
rag_chunks.worked_example: integral[0 to 3] (2x) dx = [x^2] from 0 to 3 = 3^2 - 0^2 = 9 square units.
rag_chunks.content: Integrals calculate work, centers of mass, electrical flux, and probability distributions in physical and computational systems.

subjects.subject: Computer Science
subjects.overview: Study of computers, computational systems, algorithmic efficiency, data storage, and operating architecture.

rag_chunks.definition: An algorithm is a finite, well-defined sequence of computational steps. Big-O notation categorizes algorithmic execution time and memory requirements as input size n grows.
rag_chunks.formula: Complexity Hierarchy: O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(n^2) < O(2^n).
rag_chunks.worked_example: Binary Search on a sorted array divides search intervals in half each step, achieving O(log n) time compared to linear search O(n).
rag_chunks.content: Efficient algorithm design minimizes hardware bottlenecks. Sorting techniques like Merge Sort achieve optimal worst-case O(n log n) by divide-and-conquer principles.

rag_chunks.definition: Data structures format and store information to optimize access, insertion, and manipulation.
rag_chunks.formula: Stack: Last-In-First-Out (LIFO). Queue: First-In-First-Out (FIFO). Balanced BST search complexity: O(log n).
rag_chunks.worked_example: Call stack in programming languages operates via push (function entry) and pop (function return).
rag_chunks.content: Choosing the appropriate data structure directly affects app performance. Hash tables offer expected O(1) lookups, while trees manage hierarchical data efficiently.

rag_chunks.definition: Deadlock is a state in concurrent systems where a set of processes are permanently blocked because each holds resources requested by another.
rag_chunks.formula: The 4 Coffman Conditions: 1. Mutual Exclusion 2. Hold and Wait 3. No Preemption 4. Circular Wait.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Process A holds Resource 1 and requests Resource 2. Process B holds Resource 2 and requests Resource 1. Both freeze indefinitely.
rag_chunks.content: Deadlock handling relies on prevention, avoidance using algorithms like Banker's Algorithm, or detection and automated process termination.

rag_chunks.definition: Computer networks interconnect computing nodes to exchange packetized data using layered protocol stacks.
rag_chunks.formula: TCP 3-Way Handshake: SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK. OSI Layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Browsing to https://synapse.ai triggers DNS lookup (UDP 53) to retrieve IP, then TCP 3-way handshake (TCP 443) before encrypted HTTPS packets transmit.
rag_chunks.content: The Internet is built upon TCP/IP protocol layers ensuring reliable, ordered data stream transmission.

rag_chunks.definition: A relational database management system organizes structured data into tables with schemas and foreign keys.
rag_chunks.formula: ACID Properties: Atomicity (all-or-nothing), Consistency (schema constraints), Isolation (concurrent execution), Durability (persists after crashes).
rag_chunks.worked_example: Bank fund transfer: debits Account A and credits Account B in a single transaction; if crash occurs midway, entire transaction rolls back.
rag_chunks.content: Relational databases use B-Trees for fast O(log n) index lookups and SQL queries for efficient data filtering.

subjects.subject: Data Science
subjects.overview: Multidisciplinary domain analyzing structured and unstructured data using statistics, algorithms, and visualization tools.

rag_chunks.definition: Data visualization communicates complex quantitative information clearly and efficiently through visual graphical representations.
rag_chunks.formula: Data-Ink Ratio = (Data-Ink) / (Total Ink Used in Graphic). Maximize the share of ink devoted to essential data.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Replacing cluttered 3D bar charts with clean 2D box plots removes decorative chartjunk and clarifies distribution percentiles.
rag_chunks.content: Effective data visualization empowers rapid decision making by mapping numbers to human visual perceptual channels.

rag_chunks.definition: Supervised learning trains models on labeled input-output pairs to learn a mapping function capable of predicting outputs for new data.
rag_chunks.formula: Linear Regression Loss: MSE = (1/n) * sum((y_true - y_pred)^2). Logistic Sigmoid: sigma(z) = 1 / (1 + e^(-z)).
rag_chunks.worked_example: Predicting apartment rental price based on square footage, bedrooms, and location via multi-variable linear regression.
rag_chunks.content: Supervised learning powers predictive analytics, autonomous vehicle perception, credit scoring, and automated text categorization.

rag_chunks.definition: Unsupervised learning discovers intrinsic patterns, groupings, and low-dimensional representations in unlabeled datasets.
rag_chunks.formula: K-Means Objective: min sum_k sum_{x in C_k} ||x - mu_k||^2. PCA maximizes variance along orthogonal eigenvectors of the covariance matrix.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Customer segmentation: grouping e-commerce shoppers into 5 clusters based on browsing history and purchase amounts.
rag_chunks.content: Clustering and PCA identify anomaly patterns, compress data representations, and power recommendation engines.

rag_chunks.definition: Model evaluation measures how reliably a trained model generalizes to independent, unseen test datasets.
rag_chunks.formula: Precision = TP / (TP + FP). Recall = TP / (TP + FN). F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall). Accuracy = (TP + TN) / Total.
rag_chunks.worked_example: In medical disease detection, high Recall is critical to avoid false negatives (missing an infected patient).
rag_chunks.content: Choosing appropriate metrics prevents misleading conclusions in datasets with extreme class imbalances.

subjects.subject: Artificial Intelligence
subjects.overview: Engineering intelligent agents that perceive environments, learn representations, reason, and generate solutions autonomously.

rag_chunks.topic: Artificial Neural Networks and Deep Learning
rag_chunks.definition: An artificial neural network is a computational graph composed of interconnected layers of artificial neurons applying weighted sums and non-linear activations.
rag_chunks.formula: Neuron: y = f(W^T * X + b). Activation functions include ReLU: f(z) = max(0, z) and Softmax for probability distributions.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Classifying digits from 28x28 pixel images by passing flattened 784 inputs through hidden dense layers to output 10 digit probabilities.
rag_chunks.content: Deep neural networks learn hierarchical feature representations from raw data, revolutionizing computer vision, speech synthesis, and NLP.

rag_chunks.definition: Gradient descent minimizes prediction loss by iteratively updating weights in the negative direction of the loss gradient calculated via backpropagation.
rag_chunks.formula: Weight Update: W := W - eta * grad_W(Loss). Chain Rule: dLoss/dW = (dLoss/dy) * (dy/dz) * (dz/dW).
rag_chunks.worked_example: If gradient is positive (+4.2) and learning rate eta is 0.01, the weight is decreased by 0.042 to step downhill on the loss curve.
rag_chunks.content: Backpropagation applies the differential calculus chain rule to efficiently calculate parameter gradients across all network layers.

rag_chunks.definition: The Transformer is a deep learning architecture replacing recurrent recurrence with parallel self-attention mechanisms across tokens.
rag_chunks.formula: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q * K^T) / sqrt(d_k)) * V.
rag_chunks.worked_example: In 'The animal did not cross the street because it was too tired', self-attention links 'it' to 'animal' rather than 'street'.
rag_chunks.content: Transformers form the architectural foundation of state-of-the-art Large Language Models, vision transformers, and speech encoders.

rag_chunks.definition: RAG is a framework that retrieves verified factual chunks from a knowledge base and inserts them into prompt context before generative synthesis.
rag_chunks.formula: Pipeline: Query -> Vector Embedding -> Cosine Similarity Matching -> Top-K Context Injection -> Grounded Response Synthesis.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Answering student queries with grounded curriculum chunks from on-device assets to eliminate model hallucinations.
rag_chunks.content: RAG enables lightweight local models to deliver domain-specific, factual answers without expensive full model fine-tuning.

subjects.subject: Physics
subjects.overview: Fundamental study of nature, kinematics, forces, energy conservation, wave optics, and electromagnetic fields.
topics: Newton's Laws of Motion & Classical Mechanics

rag_chunks.definition: Newton's laws of motion are three physical laws establishing relationships between physical forces and body acceleration in classical mechanics.
rag_chunks.formula: 1st Law: Inertia. 2nd Law: F_net = m * a. 3rd Law: Action = -Reaction (F_AB = -F_BA). Kinetic Energy: KE = (1/2) * m * v^2.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Accelerating a 1,200 kg car at 2.5 m/s^2 requires a net forward force of F = 1200 * 2.5 = 3,000 Newtons.
rag_chunks.content: Newton's laws explain planetary orbits, automotive safety, projectile physics, and aerospace engineering.

rag_chunks.definition: A wave is an oscillating disturbance that propagates through space or a material medium, transporting energy without permanently transporting matter.
rag_chunks.formula: Wave Equation: v = f * lambda (Speed = frequency * wavelength). Period: T = 1 / f. Sound speed in air at 20 deg C is ~343 m/s.
rag_chunks.worked_example: A musical pitch at 440 Hz (Concert A) traveling at 343 m/s in air has a wavelength lambda = 343 / 440 = 0.78 meters.
rag_chunks.content: Sound is a longitudinal mechanical pressure wave requiring a medium, whereas light is a transverse electromagnetic wave capable of traveling through vacuum.

rag_chunks.definition: Thermodynamics is the study of heat, mechanical work, temperature, and energy transformations in macroscopic physical systems.
rag_chunks.formula: 1st Law: Delta U = Q - W (Energy conservation). 2nd Law: In spontaneous isolated processes, entropy Delta S >= 0. Carnot Efficiency: eta = 1 - (T_cold / T_hot).
rag_chunks.worked_example: A gas absorbing 500 J of heat and expanding to perform 200 J of work undergoes internal energy change Delta U = 500 - 200 = 300 Joules.
rag_chunks.content: Thermodynamic laws dictate the fundamental physical efficiency limits of power generation, refrigeration, and biological metabolism.

rag_chunks.definition: Electromagnetism unifies electrical charges, currents, and magnetic fields into a single fundamental interaction of nature.
rag_chunks.formula: Ohm's Law: V = I * R. Electrical Power: P = V * I = I^2 * R. Faraday's Law: EMF = -dPhi_B / dt.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Connecting a 12V automotive battery to a 4-ohm circuit yields a current of I = 12 / 4 = 3 Amperes, consuming 36 Watts.
rag_chunks.content: Faraday's electromagnetic induction is the physical principle behind commercial electric turbine generators, transformers, and electric motors.

subjects.subject: Chemistry
subjects.overview: Study of matter, atomic electron configurations, chemical bonding, reactions, stoichiometric balances, and properties of substances.

rag_chunks.topic: Chemical Bonding: Ionic, Covalent and Metallic
rag_chunks.definition: Chemical bonds are electrostatic attractive forces holding atoms together in molecular and crystalline substances to achieve stable valence electron shells.
rag_chunks.formula: Ionic Bond: Electronegativity difference Delta EN > 2.0 (metal to non-metal electron transfer). Covalent Bond: Delta EN < 1.7 (shared electron pairs).
rag_chunks.worked_example: In NaCl (table salt), sodium (Na) transfers its outer valence electron to chlorine (Cl), forming Na+ and Cl- ions bound in a crystal lattice.
rag_chunks.content: Chemical bonding determines boiling points, molecular geometry, crystalline conductivity, and biological macromolecular folding.

rag_chunks.definition: Acids and bases are chemical compounds characterized by proton transfer. Under Bronsted-Lowry, acids donate protons (H+) while bases accept protons.
rag_chunks.formula: pH = -log10[H+]. At 25 deg C: [H+][OH-] = 1.0 * 10^(-14). pH < 7 is acidic; pH = 7 is neutral; pH > 7 is basic. Neutralization: Acid + Base -> Salt + Water.
rag_chunks.worked_example: A hydrochloric acid solution with [H+] = 0.001 M has pH = -log10(10^-3) = 3.0 (strongly acidic).
rag_chunks.content: pH balance regulates biochemical enzyme functionality in blood buffers, aquatic ecology, and industrial chemical synthesis.

rag_chunks.topic: Periodic Table and Periodic Elemental Trends
rag_chunks.definition: The Periodic Table organizes all 118 chemical elements in order of atomic number, exhibiting periodic recurring valence electron trends.
rag_chunks.formula: Across a Period (Left to Right): Atomic radius decreases; Electronegativity and Ionization Energy increase. Down a Group: Atomic radius increases.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Fluorine (F) exhibits the highest electronegativity (3.98 Pauling scale), while Francium (Fr) has the lowest.
rag_chunks.content: Periodic trends explain why alkali metals react aggressively with water while noble gases remain chemically inert.

rag_chunks.definition: Stoichiometry calculates quantitative mass-mole relationships in chemical reactions based on conservation of mass.
rag_chunks.formula: 1 mole = 6.022 * 10^23 particles (Avogadro's number). Moles n = mass (g) / Molar Mass (g/mol). Molarity = moles / Volume (L).
rag_chunks.worked_example: In 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O: 4g of H2 (2 moles) reacts with 32g of O2 (1 mole) to produce 36g of H2O (2 moles).
rag_chunks.content: Stoichiometry enables precise calculation of industrial reactant proportions and theoretical chemical reaction yields.

subjects.subject: Biology
subjects.overview: Scientific study of life, living organisms, cytology, molecular genetics, respiration, ecosystems, and biological evolution.

rag_chunks.definition: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of all known living organisms. Eukaryotic cells possess specialized membrane-bound organelles.
rag_chunks.formula: Mitochondria produce cellular ATP via oxidative phosphorylation. Nucleus stores genomic DNA. Ribosomes translate mRNA into proteins.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Human cardiac myocytes contain up to 5,000 mitochondria per cell to continuously supply ATP required for heart contractions.
rag_chunks.content: Cellular compartmentalization allows distinct metabolic reactions to occur simultaneously under regulated micro-environments.

rag_chunks.definition: Photosynthesis and cellular respiration are reciprocal biochemical pathways that cycle carbon and energy throughout the terrestrial biosphere.
rag_chunks.formula: Photosynthesis: 6CO2 + 6H2O + Photons -> C6H12O6 + 6O2. Respiration: C6H12O6 + 6O2 -> 6CO2 + 6H2O + ~32 ATP.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Green plant leaves absorb atmospheric carbon dioxide through stomata and pull water from soil roots to synthesize glucose and release oxygen.
rag_chunks.content: Photosynthesis captures solar energy into organic chemical bonds, which heterotrophic organisms consume to fuel cellular metabolism.

rag_chunks.topic: Molecular Genetics, DNA and RNA Transcription
rag_chunks.definition: Genetics examines how molecular biological traits are encoded in nucleic acids and inherited across generations.
rag_chunks.formula: Base Pairing: Adenine pairs with Thymine (A=T), Guanine pairs with Cytosine (G=C); Uracil (U) replaces Thymine in RNA. Central Dogma: DNA -> mRNA -> Protein.
rag_chunks.worked_example: A point mutation in the beta-globin gene replacing glutamic acid with valine causes sickle cell anemia.
rag_chunks.content: The genetic code is universal across Earth's biology, proving common evolutionary descent among all kingdoms of life.

subjects.subject: World History
subjects.overview: Documentation of human civilizational origins, political revolutions, social movements, global conflicts, and cultural transformations.
topics: Ancient River Valley Civilizations (Indus, Mesopotamia, Egypt)
World War I: Origins, Trench Warfare & Legacy
World War II: Global Conflict, Holocaust & the UN

rag_chunks.definition: Early complex human civilizations emerged along fertile river valleys where agricultural surpluses supported urban planning and organized statecraft.
rag_chunks.formula: Major River Basins: Indus Valley (Indus River, urban drainage grids), Mesopotamia (Tigris-Euphrates, Code of Hammurabi), Egypt (Nile River, hieroglyphs).
rag_chunks.worked_example: Excavations at Mohenjo-daro reveal sophisticated covered municipal drainage systems and standardized baked bricks dating back to 2500 BCE.
rag_chunks.content: Ancient civilizations laid the foundations for modern law codes, urban architecture, mathematics, astronomy, and written literature.

rag_chunks.definition: The Industrial Revolution (circa 1760-1840) was the transition from agrarian artisanal cottage manufacturing to automated steam-powered factory production.
rag_chunks.formula: Technological Drivers: James Watt's refined steam engine, mechanized textile power looms, coal iron smelting, and steam locomotive railways.
rag_chunks.worked_example: Manchester expanded from a market town to the global textile manufacturing capital, driving modern public labor laws and trade unions.
rag_chunks.content: Industrialization fundamentally reshaped human demographics, creating modern urban centers, globalized trade networks, and labor regulations.

rag_chunks.topic: World War II: Global Conflict, Turning Points & the UN
rag_chunks.definition: World War II (1939-1945) was a global conflict fought between the Allied Powers (USA, USSR, UK, China, France) and Axis Powers (Germany, Japan, Italy).
rag_chunks.formula: Major Turning Points: Battle of Stalingrad (1942-43), D-Day Normandy Landings (June 6, 1944), concluding with Axis surrender and United Nations formation (1945).
rag_chunks.worked_example: The post-war international order established the United Nations and Bretton Woods monetary institutions to preserve collective peace.
rag_chunks.content: World War II was the deadliest conflict in human history, resulting in the dismantling of European colonial empires and initiating the Cold War.

rag_chunks.topic: The Indian Freedom Struggle and Satyagraha
rag_chunks.definition: The Indian National Movement was a nationwide mass anti-colonial movement against British rule, pioneering non-violent civil resistance (Satyagraha).
rag_chunks.formula: Major Campaigns: 1857 First War of Independence, Non-Cooperation Movement (1920), Dandi Salt March (1930), and Quit India Movement (1942), leading to independence on August 15, 1947.
rag_chunks.worked_example: During the 240-mile Salt March, Mahatma Gandhi mobilized millions to peacefully break colonial salt monopolies, proving the power of Ahimsa.
rag_chunks.content: India's non-violent liberation struggle inspired civil rights and anti-colonial movements across Africa, Asia, and the Americas.
